tasks.label: GEOSldas: Release install (build)
args: export PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH"; source scripts/dev_env.sh; [ -f build/Makefile ] || { echo 'Missing build/Makefile. Configure first.'; exit 1; }; gmake -C build -j6 install

tasks.label: GEOSldas: Debug install (build-Debug)
args: export PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH"; source scripts/dev_env.sh; [ -f build-Debug/Makefile ] || { echo 'Missing build-Debug/Makefile. Configure first.'; exit 1; }; gmake -C build-Debug -j6 install

tasks.label: GEOSldas: Syntax check current file
args: export PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH"; source scripts/dev_env.sh; INC=''; [ -d build/include ] && INC="$INC -Ibuild/include"; [ -d build-Debug/include ] && INC="$INC -Ibuild-Debug/include"; $FC -fsyntax-only -ffree-line-length-none -ffixed-line-length-none $INC "$file"

tasks.label: GEOSldas: Smoke target (preprocess_ldas.x)
args: export PATH="/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH"; source scripts/dev_env.sh; [ -f build/Makefile ] || { echo 'Missing build/Makefile. Configure first.'; exit 1; }; gmake -C build -j4 preprocess_ldas.x
